title: hm2b.bundle/v2
description: Bundle manifest (bundle.json at the zip root). Documentation only: the hand-written validator in assembler/validate-bundle.js and assembler/checks/ is authoritative and adds no JSON Schema runtime dependency.
$comment: Rules the validator enforces and this document does not express: the declared id sets and the archive directory contents must be equal in both directions; declared knowledge-base, checklist, hooks and mcp files must exist and every other file under those areas is BUNDLE_UNEXPECTED_PATH; every step id is unique across the whole bundle; stages order and steps order are execution order; id must equal the id parsed from the release tag bundle-<id>-v<version>; requires.engine is a restricted semver range evaluated by core/semver.js; bundle paths are at most 100 UTF-8 bytes and four segments; hooks.json and mcp.json must be canonical JSON and mcp.json carries an object under mcpServers; the manifest must be canonical JSON (two-space indent, trailing LF, UTF-8, no BOM, no CR).

schema.description: Manifest schema revision; any other value stops validation with BUNDLE_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED.

name.description: Display name, counted in code points.

roles.description: Declared role ids; omitting it or writing [] both mean no roles.

knowledgeBase.description: Declared markdown knowledge files; omitting it or writing [] both mean no knowledge base.

checklists.description: Checklist ids; checklist <id> is the file checklists/<id>.md.

hooks.description: Declares hooks/hooks.json, a canonical JSON document.

mcp.description: Declares mcp.json, a canonical JSON document with an object under mcpServers.

placeholder.description: Declared placeholder; the constitution file may then be 0 bytes.

bundleId.description: The release namespace reserves the literal id hm2b.

roleId.description: The renderer owns main and sub, so a bundle role may not claim them.

skillId.description: Host skill namespaces reserve these two names.
